use normalization_adapter::Normalizer;
use serde_json::Value;

#[test]
fn every_result_and_refusal_matches_the_reference() {
    let normalizer = Normalizer::new().unwrap();
    let cases: Vec<Value> = serde_json::from_str(include_str!("cases.json")).unwrap();
    assert!(cases.len() >= 30);
    for case in cases {
        let branch = case["branch"].as_str().unwrap();
        let input = case["input"].as_str().unwrap();
        let before = input.to_owned();
        for _ in 0..2 {
            match normalizer.normalize(branch, input) {
                Ok(value) => assert_eq!(Some(&value), case.get("value"), "{case}"),
                Err(error) => assert_eq!(Some(serde_json::to_value(error.0).unwrap()), case.get("errors").cloned(), "{case}"),
            }
            assert_eq!(input, before);
        }
    }
}
